name: Remove Panel Antenna or tower mounted device
mapping_rule:
Scope: Removal, recovery, and dismantling of outdoor tower/structure-mounted panel antennas, tower mounted devices (TMD/TMA/filters), and outdoor tower RRUs.
Condition: Matches outdoor tower-mounted antennas, TMAs/TMDs, and tower RRUs marked for removal/recovery in Antenna Configuration Tables, Equipment Notes, or callout notes.
Commercial Basis: SUM_TYPES - Sum of all qualifying outdoor tower antennas, TMAs, and outdoor RRUs marked for removal (Quantity = Tower Antennas + TMDs + Tower RRUs).

name: One panel Antenna installation
mapping_rule:
Scope: Installation of primary 4G/LTE/multi-band passive panel antenna (>1.0m height).
Condition: Matches passive panel antennas proposed for installation in Antenna Configuration Table or drawing notes.
Commercial Basis: FIRST - Exactly 1 primary panel antenna per site/mount (Quantity = 1 if Total proposed >= 1, else 0; remaining go to Extra Over).

name: One panel Antenna installation- extra over
mapping_rule:
Scope: Installation of subsequent/additional 4G/multi-band passive panel antennas.
Condition: Matches additional proposed passive panel antennas on the same site/mount beyond the first primary antenna.
Commercial Basis: EXTRA - Applies to extra antennas beyond the first (Quantity = Total Proposed Panel Antennas - 1).

name: One 5G AAU Installation - first
mapping_rule:
Scope: Installation of primary 5G Active Antenna Unit (AAU / massive MIMO).
Condition: Matches proposed active 5G beamforming / AAU antenna models in Antenna Configuration Table.
Commercial Basis: FIRST - Exactly 1 primary 5G AAU per site (Quantity = 1 if Total proposed 5G AAU >= 1, else 0; remaining go to Extra Over).

name: One 5G AAU Installation - extra over
mapping_rule:
Scope: Installation of subsequent/additional 5G Active Antenna Units (AAU / massive MIMO).
Condition: Matches additional proposed 5G AAU antenna models beyond the first unit on the site.
Commercial Basis: EXTRA - Applies to extra 5G AAUs beyond the first (Quantity = Total Proposed 5G AAUs - 1).

name: GPS system swap
mapping_rule:
Scope: GPS system swap, replacement, or installation covering complete composite system.
Condition: Matches proposed or swapped GPS antennas, receiver units (GRU), surge arrestors, and sync cabling in Equipment Notes or drawing notes.
Commercial Basis: COMPOSITE_ONE - Bundles all constituent GPS hardware elements into a single composite system line item (Quantity = 1).

name: Tower Mounted Device - First (TMA, COM,FILTER)
mapping_rule:
Scope: Installation of primary Tower Mounted Device (TMA, combiner, tower filter, diplexer, triplexer).
Condition: Matches proposed TMAs, TMDs, or tower filters in Equipment Notes or Antenna Configuration Tables.
Commercial Basis: FIRST - Exactly 1 primary TMD unit per site (Quantity = 1 if Total proposed TMDs >= 1, else 0; remaining go to Extra Over).

name: Tower Mounted Device (TMD) - Extra over W7893 for Each additional
mapping_rule:
Scope: Installation of subsequent/additional Tower Mounted Devices (TMA, combiner, tower filter, diplexer, triplexer).
Condition: Matches additional proposed TMAs, TMDs, or tower filters beyond the first unit on site.
Commercial Basis: EXTRA - Applies to extra tower mounted devices beyond the first (Quantity = Total Proposed TMDs - 1).

name:
Relocate existing antenna, RRU or Tower Mounted
Device up to 3 metres
mapping_rule:
Scope: Relocation, repositioning, or height/azimuth adjustment up to 3 metres for existing antennas, RRUs, or Tower Mounted Devices.
Condition: Matches existing antennas, RRUs, or TMDs designated for relocation / move in Antenna Configuration Tables or Equipment Notes.
Commercial Basis: ALL - Sum of all units marked for relocation within 3 metres (Quantity = Total Relocated Units).

name: Remote Radio Unit - First (RRU)
mapping_rule:
Scope: Installation of primary outdoor tower/mast/structure-mounted Remote Radio Unit (RRU).
Condition: Matches proposed outdoor tower-mounted RRUs/radios in Equipment Notes or drawing callouts (excluding shelter RRUs).
Commercial Basis: FIRST - Exactly 1 primary outdoor RRU per site (Quantity = 1 if Total proposed outdoor RRUs >= 1, else 0; remaining go to Extra Over).

name: RRU x 1 - Extra over W12252 for each additional
mapping_rule:
Scope: Installation of subsequent/additional outdoor tower/structure-mounted Remote Radio Units (RRU).
Condition: Matches additional proposed outdoor tower-mounted RRUs beyond the first unit on site (excluding shelter RRUs).
Commercial Basis: EXTRA - Applies to extra outdoor RRUs beyond the first (Quantity = Total Proposed Outdoor RRUs - 1).

name: PIM/Sweep testing to reused existing spare feeder (per feeder)
mapping_rule:
Scope: PIM (Passive Intermodulation) and return loss sweep testing on existing and spare transmission lines (coaxial feeder cables & hybrid trunk cables) designated to be reused on site.
Condition: Matches existing RF coaxial feeder cables and hybrid trunk cables designated for reuse / retained in Equipment Notes, Cable Schedules, or drawing callout notes.
Commercial Basis: REUSED_CABLES - 1 test unit per retained/reused feeder or hybrid run (Quantity = Total Reused Coaxial Feeders + Total Reused Hybrid Cables).

name: Recovery of Baseband Unit, DUS or R503 (or similar)
mapping_rule:
Scope: Decommissioning, removal, and recovery of internal shelter equipment rack units (Baseband units, Digital units, R503, rack fiber trays).
Condition: Matches internal shelter rack units marked for removal/recovery or negative proposed quantity in Shelter Equipment Schedules or Equipment Notes.
Commercial Basis: ALL - Sum of absolute net proposed removal quantities (Quantity = abs(Proposed BB) + abs(Proposed DU) + abs(Proposed R503) + abs(Proposed Fiber Trays)).

name: Install a Site RP6672
mapping_rule:
Scope: Installation, mounting, and commissioning of indoor site routers, ERAN switches, or Radio Processors (RP6672) within equipment racks.
Condition: Matches proposed indoor routers, ERAN switches, or Radio Processors in Equipment Notes or Shelter Equipment Schedules.
Commercial Basis: ALL - Total proposed count of new indoor routers / Radio Processors to install (Quantity = Total Proposed Units).

name: Relocate Site Cell Router
mapping_rule:
Scope: Relocation, repositioning, and rack re-mounting of existing shelter rack units (site routers, SIU, slideout fiber management trays).
Condition: Matches existing shelter rack units designated with action RELOCATE / MOVE in Equipment Notes or Shelter Layout Notes.
Commercial Basis: ALL - Total count of existing shelter router and tray units relocated between rack positions (Quantity = Total Relocated Rack Units).

name: Testing of 4G/5G Installation using Blackbird App including all required Call / Data Tests (first carrier per sector only)
mapping_rule:
Scope: Blackbird call and data testing covering the first carrier on each proposed technology-sector (4G and 5G sectors).
Condition: Matches active proposed antenna installations grouped by technology and sector in Antenna Configuration Tables or layout sheets.
Commercial Basis: PER_SECTOR - 1 test unit per active proposed technology-sector across the site (Quantity = Count of Proposed 4G Sectors + Count of Proposed 5G Sectors).

name: Testing of 4G/5G Installation using Blackbird App including all required Call / Data Tests (extra over first carrier per sector for each subsequent carrier per sector)
mapping_rule:
Scope: Blackbird testing for all subsequent/extra-over carriers beyond the first carrier on each proposed antenna/technology-sector.
Condition: Matches additional carrier line entries/ports beyond the first per proposed antenna in Antenna Configuration Tables.
Commercial Basis: EXTRA_CARRIER - Sum of extra carriers across all proposed antennas (Quantity = Sum of Max(0, Carriers per Proposed Antenna - 1)).

name: RRU installed in shelter
mapping_rule:
Scope: Installation and mounting of Remote Radio Units (RRU) internally within the equipment shelter or indoor equipment room.
Condition: Matches proposed RRUs explicitly designated for shelter / indoor room installation in Equipment Notes or Shelter Layout Schedules.
Commercial Basis: ALL - Total proposed shelter RRU count (Quantity = Total Proposed Shelter RRUs).

name: RRU recovery from shelter
mapping_rule:
Scope: Removal, recovery, and decommissioning of Remote Radio Units (RRU) located internally within the equipment shelter or indoor equipment room.
Condition: Matches internal shelter RRUs marked for removal/recovery in Equipment Notes or Shelter Schedules.
Commercial Basis: ALL - Total shelter RRU count to recover (Quantity = Total Shelter RRUs to Recover).

name: Feeder – (15m – 50m) Structure - ½” Feeder Cable x 1 (single)
mapping_rule:

Condition: Matches proposed ½” (e.g. LCF12, LDF4, 1/2") feeder cables in Equipment Notes or Cable Schedule, cross-verified with layout pages (return table quantity if matching, or table quantity with mismatch comment if different).
Commercial Basis: SINGLE - Applies to single ½” cable run or odd run remaining after pairs (15m–50m base length).

name: Feeder – (15m – 50m) Structure - ½” Feeder Cable x 2 (one pair)

Commercial Basis: PAIR - Applies per pair of ½” feeder cable runs (Quantity = floor(Proposed ½” Runs / 2)).

name: Feeder– ½” x 1 - Extra Over for additional increment per lineal metre
mapping_rule:

Condition: Matches proposed ½” (e.g. LCF12, LDF4, 1/2") feeder cable runs with total route length > 50m in Cable Schedule or drawing notes.
Commercial Basis: EXTRA_OVER_LM - Per lineal metre exceeding 50m per run (Quantity = Sum of Max(0, Route Length - 50m) across qualifying ½” runs).
